items.spec_zh: 原V4为电源正/负/PWM三线；线长按安装位置实测定制，不采用Pro三相线接法。
items.spec_en: The original V4 uses power-positive, power-negative and PWM wires. Measure cable lengths on the selected frame; do not use the Pro three-phase wiring scheme.
items.status_en: Listed in source; verify before purchase

items.spec_zh: 旧电路表和V4-ly固件保留4路；按当前相机/机构实装数量确认。
items.spec_en: The older electrical list and V4-ly firmware retain four channels. Confirm the installed camera/mechanism configuration.
items.status_en: Conflicting sources; confirm against the vehicle

items.spec_zh: 配件表：不锈钢、10m选项；旧商品标题含MS5837-30BA。选项/实际型号须核对，10m不是整机潜深。 旧接线使用随附转接板，需核对是否包含在传感器供货中。

items.status_en: Listed in source; verify before purchase
